title: Wild AG process
description: A taupe-to-sand band with a 73px rounded bottom: a paper serif-italic title and two paragraphs at the left, three numbered pills outlined in paper at the right (paper disc, taupe number, bold label, arrow), vertically centred against each other. On phones the text sits above the pills. Text fades up on entering view; pills lose their outline and tint on hover.
notes: paper-coloured text on the brand gradient in both modes
sits above the next section (z-10) so a following block with tuck shows around its rounded corners
name: wild-ag-process
